events.name: Flash Couple Silhouette
events.description: The two of you close together on pure black, a warm light behind you drawing a gold outline around your hair and shoulders, your faces softly dim, and one small white heart floating in the dark above you.

events.name: Give It All
events.description: You rap at a hanging vintage mic in a packed cinema lobby, the crowd pressed in behind you, rolling your arms on the beat, then lean in close and wave your hands as the verse hits.

events.name: Jingle Bell Brazil Dance
events.description: Three dancers in Santa hats stand in a row under blue LED light, then cross their arms, tap their chests, bring a hand to the mouth and bounce in sync to a Brazilian funk Jingle Bell Rock.

events.name: Lisa Crab Dance
events.description: You do the Thai crab dance in a bright white dance room: crab-pincer hands, low knee bounces, side sways and a straight face, one full-length take.

events.name: Never Let Her Pay
events.description: At a lamp-lit restaurant table, the date holds out a card; the guest in the cream dinner jacket waves it away, unzips a black pouch on a kitchen sponge, and the waiter walks them off to wash the dishes.

events.name: NYC Rats
events.description: A shaky night phone clip in a New York alley: the rat gang stands up on two legs and fights the camera. Your pet is the rat in front.

events.name: Snowman Dance
events.description: A couple in matching red plaid pyjama trousers do the Snowman dance by the fireplace and the lit Christmas tree: hands behind their backs, a spin under the arm, twirls hand in hand, then one jumps up and gets carried piggyback up to the phone.

events.name: We Don't Talk Anymore Dance
events.description: One dancer alone on an empty stage in front of a black curtain, under a row of small spotlights, freestyling to the "We Don't Talk Anymore" sound: arms flung wide, two hair flips, a turn, knee lifts and a deep squat that ends in a hair whip.
